_summary: Read in full on 2026-09-24. The candidate with the fixes from runs 10 to 12. 22 of 24 passed automatically; under the checks as they are now, 21. Fixed since run 12: b-limits writes the daily floor as the day's start less quota × 4%; o-predict names no place for prices; o-montecarlo prints one tier line; s-firm quotes no fee and says nothing of an earlier draft; ex-kelly now puts its one-line answer (17.5%) after the refusal. The errors: b-stop chose a stop 1.5% below entry and worked out its price itself, 76,705 (1.5% below 77,872 is 76,703.92), wrote 'Result first:' and 'stop_pct', and gave its formula and why it works twice, once before the tool call and once after. o-montecarlo wrote 'One-line answer:', named the calc '`kelly`', and said half-Kelly is above the risk 'any prop-firm ceiling troid has read would allow' with no tool behind it. s-firm said 'Bitfunded is the one troid has verified most completely' to a beginner asking which firm is best, singling out one firm, and not so: Crypto Fund Trader's recorded coverage equals it. q-stats' automated failure was the checker's: it put troid's out-of-sample result first as 'on data it was never tuned on', and the check wanted the words 'out of sample'. Staged for run 14: trade_math's position_size takes a stop as a percent; text written before a tool call goes when the final answer gives its method sections again; lints for 'result first' and 'one-line answer', a calc's name, an unsourced claim about every rule troid has read, and a firm singled out; a guardrail on percent stops and on naming no favourite firm. Checks added to match. Not promoted.
